description: This source file implements GnuTLS-specific SSL/TLS backend functionalities for cURL, including connection setup, handshake, certificate verification, session management, data transmission, and cleanup procedures tailored to GnuTLS API.

classes.name: gtls_ssl_backend_data
classes.description: Holds GnuTLS session and credential handles, as well as trust setup state

methods.name: ssize_t gtls_push(void * s,const void * buf,size_t blen)

methods.description: Receives data from the GnuTLS session, handling trust setup and peer closure.

methods.name: int gtls_init(void)
methods.description: Performs global initialization of GnuTLS library, guarded to run once.

methods.name: void gtls_cleanup(void)
methods.description: Deinitializes GnuTLS library if previously initialized.
